status_drift.note: Issue #18331 closed via merged PR #18333 during collection, after the frozen issue-creation membership cutoff. Latest observed closed/merged states are shown.

scope: Issues authored by enyst or smolpaws and created from Monday 5 October 2026 00:00 Europe/Stockholm inclusive through the frozen issue-creation membership cutoff; latest issue/PR states observed during collection; implementation PRs in OpenHands/OpenHands across all states and authors. PR creation has no lower time cutoff. Inventory only; no fixes, reviews or closures performed.
criterion: Own PR means an identified implementation/proposed fix/partial implementation authored by enyst or smolpaws, across open, merged and closed-unmerged states. Incidental QA, issue-filing and documentation references to product bugs are excluded. Documentation/test/harness implementation counts when that is the issue itself. Matched merged PRs are distinct from GitHub direct closers. This inventory does not verify that merged PRs satisfy every requirement.

methodology.issue_enumeration: Paginated official REST /repos/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues?creator=<author>&state=all&sort=created&direction=desc, excluding PR records; stopped only once results predated the cutoff. Exact UTC comparison retained 117 issues; independent complete GitHub Search returned the identical issue-number set.
methodology.timelines: Every issue REST timeline paginated to exhaustion. Supplemented all issue GraphQL ClosedEvent/ReopenedEvent histories and CrossReferencedEvent/ConnectedEvent histories with pageInfo exhaustion.
methodology.reference_limitation: REST timelines returned no cross-referenced events. GraphQL returned one cross-repository website PR mention and no same-repository PR cross references; complete reverse-reference audits supplement these sparse results. Absence means no corresponding implementation PR identified by this protocol.

own_author_reverse_audit.description: All repo PRs authored by enyst or smolpaws across all states, without a creation-time lower cutoff; paginated complete search with incomplete_results=false. Exact issue-number/body references and URL references reviewed.

all_author_reverse_audit.description: All repo PRs updated since cohort start across all states and authors; complete paginated search with incomplete_results=false. A new issue reference normally updates its PR, so this supplements missing timeline cross references.

methodology.additional_candidates: Semantic exact duplicate-scope matching (#17898/#18081/#18086) and tracker-child partial implementation (#18004/#18331/#18333), independently audited; direct GitHub ClosedEvent pull-request closers; exact pull-request URLs in issue bodies/comments; exact cohort issue references in candidate PR titles/bodies.
methodology.classification: Every candidate issue/PR match manually classified from public summaries/reference contexts; all exclusions retained with reasons. No PR implementation code copied or reused.
methodology.snapshot_consistency: Issue creation membership is frozen at the stated cutoff and independently verified. Issue/PR states use the latest observations during the fetch interval, with per-record timestamps. #18331 closed via merged #18333 during collection, after the membership cutoff; actual current closed/merged state is shown and recorded in status_drift.

records.title: [Bug]: VITE_DO_NOT_TRACK=1 still initializes PostHog and loads remote scripts from the telemetry host
records.author: enyst

own_prs.title: fix(telemetry): never initialize PostHog under Do Not Track
own_prs.author: enyst
own_prs.scope: Fixes the same Do Not Track telemetry-initialization cause as duplicate issue #18081; #17898 remains an open issue-state reconciliation candidate despite this merged fix.

reference_contexts: PR #18086 implements the same no-initialization/no-network Do Not Track scope as #17898; its explicit fixing reference is duplicate #18081. #17898 remains open, so this is a scope match rather than a direct issue closer.

issue only removes the PostHog requests the live guard observes.
- The pre-consent `canvas_install` behavior when Do Not Track is off is unchanged.
- #17898 reports the same root cause for the production `bin/agent-canvas.mjs` build; consolidating the two issues is a maintainer call and does not change this scope.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With `VITE_DO_NOT_TRACK=1`, `initializePostHogClient()` resolves `null` and the `posthog-js` `init` function is never called, including when reached through `TelemetryProvider` mount, `trackInstall()`, `trackEvent()`, `trackSessionStart()`, `setTelemetryConsent("granted")`, and `setTelemetryIdentity(...)`.
- [ ] The same holds when Do Not Track comes

Issue #17898 acceptance: - [ ] In a build with `VITE_DO_NOT_TRACK=1`, loading any page makes zero requests to the PostHog host.
- [ ] `initializePostHogClient()` returns `null` without calling `posthog.init` when `isDoNotTrackEnabled()` is true.
- [ ] A unit test in `__tests__/services/telemetry.test.ts` covers the `VITE_DO_NOT_TRACK` path, mirroring the existing runtime-flag tests.

records.title: [Bug]: Files tab keeps showing stale file content after Refresh (and even after a reload)
records.author: enyst

own_prs.title: fix(files): show the current file body after Refresh and reload
own_prs.author: enyst
own_prs.scope: Revalidates workspace file content after Refresh and reload instead of reusing stale HTTP cache.

reference_contexts:
ter a page reload, for both the text preview and the rich HTML/image preview.

## Why

When a file open in the Files tab changed on disk, the tab kept showing the old content after Refresh, and even after a full reload (#17921).

Root cause: the Agent Server's workspace fileserver sends `Last-Modified` and `ETag` but no `Cache-Control`, so Chromium applies heuristic freshness (about 10% of the file's age) and answers repeat requests from its HTTP cache.
- Text preview: `useWorkspaceFileContent` fetched with the default cache mode, so React Query's refetch got the cached

t invalidation is removed, since it only caused a duplicate request.
- The counter starts at the page-load time instead of 0, so a reload never rebuilds a `?v=` URL cached during an earlier load.

## Issue Number

Fixes #17921

## How to Test

Unit tests and lint:

```bash
npx vitest run __tests__/hooks/query/use-workspace-file-content.test.tsx __tests__/routes/files-tab.test.tsx __tests__/stores/use-workspace-mutation-counter.test.ts __tests__/components/features/files-tab __tests__/hooks/use-auto-refresh-files-on-edit.test.tsx
npm run lint
```

- On the fixed code: 8

other_prs.author: GoldArowana
other_prs.scope: Flushes pending debounced conversation drafts before navigation using the captured conversation identity.

reference_contexts:
UMAN:

I reviewed the before-and-after recordings and confirmed that drafts are preserved when switching conversations or navigating to Settings and back, without mixing drafts between conversations.

---

AGENT:

Fixes #17926.

## Why

Conversation edits made within the 500 ms debounce window can be lost during navigation, restoring an older draft instead.

## Summary

Pending conversation drafts are flushed before navigation or unmount using the captured conversation identity. Multiline text and `clearDraft` semantics are preserved. Home draft and task-ID behavior are

re preserved. Home draft and task-ID behavior are unchanged. Regression tests cover rapid conversation switching, Settings/Back navigation, multiline drafts, cleared drafts, and conversation isolation.

## Issue Number

#17926 is labeled `ready-for-dev`.

## How to Test

The recorded production app ran with `node bin/agent-canvas.mjs`, local AgentServer 1.50.1, automation 1.17.0, and Chromium. Edit a saved draft and navigate within 500 ms: switch conversations and return; open Settings and go Back; enter multiline text, open New Chat, and return. Confirm the latest text

own_prs.scope: Reports conversation download failures once and makes the default sidebar layout match Recent.

reference_contexts:
error toast and close the menu, and makes the default sidebar layout match the Recent preset so the View menu no longer reads "Custom" on an untouched profile.

## Why

Two problems in the sidebar conversation list (#17943):

- **Download failure.** When downloading a conversation failed (for example the agent server was unreachable), the user saw two toasts: "ConversationId unknown, cannot download trajectory", which is wrong because the id is known, plus the raw 502 from the global handler. The context menu also stayed open, and the rejection escaped as an uncau

ection and close the menu, as on success.
- The Recent preset is now exactly `DEFAULT_LAYOUT_SETTINGS`, so a fresh profile shows Recent checked; changing any layout field still reads Custom.

## Issue Number

Fixes #17943

## How to Test

Unit tests and lint (each new test fails on `main` and passes here):

```bash
npx vitest run __tests__/components/features/conversation-panel/ \
  __tests__/stores/conversation-panel-preferences-store.test.ts \
  __tests__/hooks/use-conversation-name-context-menu.test.tsx \
  __tests__/hooks/use-download-conversation.tes

other_prs.title: fix(automations): validate a cleared time of day before saving
other_prs.author: gold-beyond
other_prs.scope: Validates a cleared time-of-day schedule before saving; explicitly addresses only item 1 of this four-part issue.

reference_contexts:
fix(automations): validate a cleared time of day before saving
HUMAN:

This was reproduced on a local mock Canvas while working through item 1 of #17948, and I've reviewed the fix and the before/after evidence above. With Time of day cleared, Save now keeps the dialog open with an inline required-field error and sends no request; re-entering a time saves the rebuilt cron. The automation detail tests pass (26/26). Opening this as the item-1 fix.


AGENT:

**What changed** — the Edit automation

and an empty value fell through silently. When another field had also changed, Save PATCHed just that field and toasted "Automation updated", so nothing told the user the schedule edit was lost.

Reported as item 1 of #17948 and documented as `F23.edit-time-cleared` in `.agents/skills/verify-openhands/references/feature-map/F23-automation-detail.md` ("Expected: an inline message and the dialog stays open").

## Summary

- `handleSubmit` validates the time like the name and timeout fields: an empty or malformed value sets the schedule error and returns before any P

me case asserts the field-bound error, no PATCH, no success toast and no close; a second test covers recovery (re-enter a time → the retry PATCHes the rebuilt schedule).

## Issue Number

Addresses the first item of #17948 (the issue's other three items are untouched by this PR).

## How to Test

1. `npm run dev:mock`, open an automation's detail page, then **Automation actions → Edit**.
2. Clear **Time of day** and click **Save**.
   - Before: the dialog closes with no request and no message; reopening Edit shows the old time.
   - After: the dialog stays op

this size of change.

## Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Docs / chore

## Notes

- Draft on purpose: the `HUMAN:` note above belongs to the human contributor, and #17948 still needs `ready-for-dev` from a maintainer — the triage there asked for per-item reproduction evidence, and the item-1 screenshots are now posted in the issue thread.
- Copy choice: the error reuses the existing, fully translated `ERROR$REQUIRED_FIELD` ("This field is required") instead of adding a new `AUTOMATIONS$*` key. Happy to switch to f

other_prs.title: fix(agent-canvas): honor launcher runtime flags
other_prs.author: FanouZeng-TT
other_prs.scope: Honors the LAN session-key option, cleans busy-port errors and corrects backend-only runtime metadata.

reference_contexts:
th also printed busy-port errors twice because it emitted both the message and a stack whose first line repeated that message. Finally, backend-only runtime metadata described a frontend route that did not exist.

Fixes #17949

records.title: [Bug]: Live E2E (CI › live-e2e) never passes on main: tmux socket path too long, critic endpoint 404, teardown hang
records.author: enyst

own_prs.title: fix(e2e): let the live Agent Server E2E job run and finish
own_prs.author: enyst
own_prs.scope: Repairs the reported live E2E teardown, tmux socket path and critic endpoint setup.

reference_contexts:
his is one of three PRs split from the original fix for red CI on `main`; the other two are #18086 (Do Not Track) and #18087 (Mock-LLM preset automation spec).

## Why

`CI › live-e2e` has not passed on `main` in weeks (#18082). This PR fixes the three test-harness problems:

- **Teardown hang.** Playwright's default teardown SIGKILLs the webServer's process group. `dev-safe.mjs` spawns the Agent Server detached, so it survives as an orphan holding the webServer's stdout/stderr. Playwright waits for those pipes until the 30-minute job timeout, and the job ends **cancell

es.
- `tests/e2e/live/utils/agent-server-conversation.ts`: the critic keeps the Agent Server's default endpoint and model; only `critic_api_key` is passed.
- `e2e-testing` guide updated for both.

## Issue Number

## Why

When branching from a user message in conversation view, the forked conversation pre-fills the message text into the composer, but the Send button remained disabled (issue #18202). `useDraftPersistence` restored the draft into the contentEditable DOM element (`element.textContent = draftMessage`) without dispatching an `input` event, leaving `CustomChatInput`'s `canSubmit` state as `false` until the user manually typed a character.

other_prs.title: fix(automations): poll in-flight draft test runs until terminal status is reached
other_prs.author: lx3133584
other_prs.scope: Polls in-flight automation draft test runs until their status becomes terminal.

reference_contexts:
ut the panel only fetched draft runs once on initial draft materialization. Because no background polling existed, the Test runs view remained stuck showing `Pending` for completed runs until a manual page reload (issue #18263).

## Summary

- **Active In-Flight Polling**:
  - Added a 3-second polling interval in `AutomationSetupPanel` that activates whenever `draftAutomationId` exists and `draftRuns` contains at least one non-terminal run (`PENDING` or `RUNNING`).
  - Calls `AutomationService.listAutomationRuns` and updates `draftRuns` with the latest server state, mer

tomations/automation-setup-panel.test.tsx` verifying that in-flight test runs poll until reaching terminal status (`COMPLETED` -> `Successful` and `FAILED`), and that polling stops once terminal. ## Issue Number Fixes #18263 ## How to Test Run the automation setup panel test suite: ```bash npm test -- __tests__/components/automations/automation-setup-panel.test.tsx npm test -- __tests__/components/automations/ __tests__/routes/automation ``` Verify TypeScript types: ```bash npm run typecheck ``` ## Video/Screenshots

a defect found in a pass was not always recorded in the map.

## Summary

- **Rule: the map knows every open bug** (`SKILL.md`, `maintenance.md`, `daily.md`, `mapping.md`).

`BASE` that name a mapped feature: they reproduce each one and add its note. When one doesn't reproduce, they comment on the issue with the run instead.

- **F01, Gotchas:** the entry that still described #17884's settings-diff bug now describes the profile-first LLM step from #18218. That covers which profile it edits, the wait for a reachable backend, the load error with Retry, and Next without

never writes to the form.
